document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>openProject(b.dataset.open));document.getElementById('close').onclick=closeProject;overlay.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeProject()};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!overlay.classList.contains('show'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')closeProject();if(e.key==='ArrowRight'&&allSlides[activeId]&&page<allSlides[activeId].length-1){page++;render()}if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'&&allSlides[activeId]&&page>0){page--;render()}});document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));b.classList.add('active');document.querySelectorAll('.project').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('hidden',b.dataset.filter!=='全部作品'&&c.dataset.type!==b.dataset.filter));});
